peak_metric_meaning: The panel is titled 'Peak usage per model compared to its limit over the last 28 days'. Each figure is the MAXIMUM seen in any single window during those 28 days (highest requests in one minute for RPM; highest requests in one day for RPD; highest input tokens in one minute for TPM). '25/20' therefore means: on at least one day in the last 28, 25 requests were counted against a 20/day limit. It does NOT say which day, whether that day was today, how many requests are used today, or how many remain. It is not a remaining-quota figure and today's remaining quota must not be inferred from it. Unknown from the dashboard: whether rejected (429) requests are counted in the 25. Same reading for 6/5 RPM. For the Key 2 panel, 3/20 is likewise a peak, not proof of 17 remaining.
